source: AEMET Barajas station 08221 hourly synoptic archive
spatial_resolution_support: Point (airport station ~13 km NE of corridor); applied uniformly to whole grid
independent_from_model_evaluated: No — this IS the model forcing (not independent)
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: Yes — airport-vs-centre bias shifts absolute UTCI but is applied identically to both routes so is largely differenced out; residual risk if bias interacts with local geometry
known_limitations: Airport siting not city-core; single-point wind not spatially resolved; synoptic not microscale forcing
gate2_proposed_treatment: Reuse as common forcing for BOTH routes; hold forcing identical across the paired comparison so it cannot by itself flip a within-pair difference; a municipal full-met station may serve as an alternative forcing (still non-corridor)

source: Ayuntamiento de Madrid municipal network - Datos meteorologicos horarios desde 2019 (Escuelas Aguirre urban station, Ta/RH); Retiro official daily-max/monthly-mean and ERA5-Land as regional context
publisher: Ayuntamiento de Madrid; AEMET; ECMWF/Copernicus C3S
dataset_product: Datos meteorologicos. Datos horarios desde 2019 (dataset 300352); AEMET Retiro summaries; ERA5-Land
url_or_provenance: datos.madrid.es dataset 300352; airedemadrid.madrid.es Red de meteorologia; docs/PHASE1_1_SENSITIVITY_REPORT.md
version_date_campaign: Municipal hourly Jan-2019 onward; Retiro 2023 daily/monthly; ERA5-Land hourly
spatial_resolution_support: Point (Escuelas Aguirre, Calle Alcala/O'Donnell, a few hundred m E of OD1 destination); Point (Retiro); ~9 km grid (ERA5-Land)
temporal_resolution_support: Escuelas Aguirre HOURLY Ta/RH; Retiro daily/monthly; ERA5-Land hourly coarse
independent_from_model_evaluated: Yes for the urban Ta/RH check (independent of Barajas forcing); ERA5-Land is reanalysis context
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: No direct — the check bounds forcing plausibility, not the comparison outcome
known_limitations: Escuelas Aguirre reports Ta/RH but NOT wind and NOT solar radiation; only the six peripheral municipal met stations (Moratalaz, Villaverde, Hortaleza, Z.I. Fuencarral, EDAR La China, Centro Municipal de Acustica) measure wind+radiation, none in the corridor; per-station variable roster to confirm at file level
gate2_proposed_treatment: Use Escuelas Aguirre hourly Ta/RH as the corridor-adjacent independent check and as the empirical basis for E-P1; keep Retiro/ERA5-Land as regional context; state explicitly it does NOT validate Tmrt/UTCI; wind/radiation checks remain non-local

source: IGN/CNIG PNOA-LiDAR MDT (terrain) + MDSn edificacion (building nDSM) via WCS; superseded as PRIMARY by municipal MDS 2023 / MDT 2019 (see L15)
spatial_resolution_support: 2.5 m building nDSM (native); 5 m DEM resampled to 2.5 m
crs: EPSG:25830 (WCS returns malformed LOCAL_CS; re-tagged; no pixel change)
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: Possibly — building edits since 2008-2015 could alter shadow geometry on one route; low in protected heritage core; largely mitigated by adopting MDS 2023
known_limitations: ~8-15 yr vintage; retained as cross-check/fallback now that MDS 2023 (L15) offers a 2023 surface
gate2_proposed_treatment: Demote PNOA to cross-check/fallback; prefer MDS 2023 - MDT 2019 for the building surface at a 2023+ study day; keep PNOA to test geometry-source sensitivity

source: IGN/CNIG PNOA-LiDAR MDSn vegetacion (veg nDSM) via WCS; augmented by MDS 2023 surface (L15) and municipal tree inventory (L16)
spatial_resolution_support: 2.5 m native (PNOA canopy height); 1 m (MDS 2023); point (inventory)
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: YES — still the dominant direction-changing uncertainty, but REDUCED: MDS 2023 + tree inventory bound the decade of canopy change far better than the 2008-2015 raster alone
known_limitations: MDS 2023 is unclassified (no building/canopy split) and photogrammetric (no crown transmissivity, no sub-canopy, leaf-state = 2023 flight date); tree inventory gives presence+height not crown polygons/history/hour-specific shade; PNOA is stale
gate2_proposed_treatment: MANDATORY perturbation dimension at Gate 2 (E-P2): bound canopy across PNOA 2008-2015 vs MDS-2023 canopy height vs tree-inventory presence audit vs Copernicus TCD 2018; if the comparison reverses across these -> ABSTAIN

dataset_product: OSM ways (pedestrian network) — NOT YET FETCHED
url_or_provenance: No file in repo; existing data/raw/osm/*.json pulls fetched POIs/buildings/trees/water/transit ONLY
version_date_campaign: Live OSM (would be fetched at Gate 2)
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: YES — if the walkable graph is wrong or incomplete on one route the paired comparison is invalid at source
known_limitations: No pedestrian network was ever assembled by HATI; sidewalk mapping in Madrid is incomplete/inconsistent; side-of-street ambiguity unmodelled
gate2_proposed_treatment: Acquire via bounded Overpass query for the two fixed routes only (small query; allowed); manually audit each route link against aerial imagery; freeze the two polylines as versioned GeoJSON BEFORE any thermal run

source: OSM crossings + access tags + manual heritage/pedestrian-zone check
dataset_product: Crossing nodes / access tags / pedestrian-zone geometry
url_or_provenance: To be derived from L05 fetch; manual check
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: YES — a route that is not legally/physically walkable (missing crossing; private; closed) invalidates the pair
known_limitations: Crossings/sidewalk connectivity not audited; Paseo del Prado is a wide multi-lane axis with specific legal crossing points; park gates have opening hours
gate2_proposed_treatment: Manually verify both routes are legally + physically walkable end-to-end; record every controlled crossing and every park gate used; flag any access uncertainty as an ABSTAIN trigger

source: Local civil time Europe/Madrid mapped to forcing hours
known_limitations: Diurnal solar geometry depends on correct local-solar-time handling; DST must be explicit
gate2_proposed_treatment: Fix the departure-hour set explicitly in Europe/Madrid; document UTC offset; align forcing hour to solar-geometry hour with no silent shift

source: Composite of all input reference dates
version_date_campaign: Various (municipal met 2019+; MDS 2023; MDT 2019; PNOA 2008-2015; TCD 2018; inventory 2025/2026)
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: Yes (indirectly — vintage mismatch is the core risk)
known_limitations: After the correction the best-aligned era is 2023+ (municipal hourly + MDS 2023); a pre-2019 day forfeits the urban hourly check and MDS-2023 alignment
gate2_proposed_treatment: Carry the full vintage table into Gate 2; prefer inputs+day aligned to the same era; every claim states the vintage of the geometry it rests on

publisher: AEMET / IGN-CNIG / OSM / Copernicus / Ayto. Madrid
licence_reuse: AEMET open; IGN/CNIG open; OSM ODbL (share-alike; attribution); Copernicus open; Madrid open (incl. MDS/MDT/arbolado/meteo)
known_limitations: OSM ODbL share-alike obliges attribution + share-alike on derived network products; repo has no LICENSE file (owner decision; see PROJECT_STATUS.md)
gate2_proposed_treatment: Attribute all sources; publish derived route geometry under ODbL-compatible terms; do not let the unset repo licence block internal research use

source: Historical opening hours (assets) + full diurnal meteorology
dataset_product: Opening hours + hourly forcing across the day
temporal_resolution_support: Hours = daily schedule (2026 vintage); met = hourly
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: Possibly — a time-shift comparison depends on hours + diurnal geometry both being right for the study day
known_limitations: 2026 opening hours applied to a historical day is an acknowledged mismatch; a 2023/2024 study day narrows this gap; diurnal shade geometry changes strongly across the day
gate2_proposed_treatment: If a departure-time comparison is attempted; treat 2026 hours as provisional and flag; prefer within-day geometry contrast over cross-day behavioural claims

source: pvlib Ineichen clear-sky model (real solar geometry + Linke turbidity climatology); NO corridor-local radiation observation exists
publisher: Project-computed (pvlib) + Open-Meteo radiation as cross-ref; municipal met stations / AEMET Ciudad Universitaria as regional radiation check
dataset_product: Modeled clear-sky GHI; Open-Meteo radiation json
version_date_campaign: Computed per timestamp for true date/time
licence_reuse: pvlib open; Open-Meteo open; municipal open
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: Yes if cloud/aerosol differs from clear-sky assumption — but applied identically to both routes so largely differenced out
known_limitations: No corridor-local pyranometer; the six peripheral municipal met stations and AEMET Ciudad Universitaria measure radiation but are not in the corridor (regional check only); clear-sky valid only for confirmed-clear hours (coco=1); SOLWEIG Ldown +18..55 W/m2 known bias
gate2_proposed_treatment: Restrict any thermal run to confirmed clear-sky hours; apply identical radiation to both routes; optionally sanity-check modeled GHI against a peripheral municipal radiation station for the chosen day; treat radiation realisation as a perturbation dim only if a route has asymmetric sky-view

source: SOLWEIG package default (no site-specific land-cover raster)
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: Low-moderate — uniform surface assumption approximates albedo/emissivity equally on both routes
known_limitations: No study-area-specific pavement/grass/water classification; refines but does not enable Tmrt
gate2_proposed_treatment: Optional Gate 2 refinement; only pursue if a route crosses a strongly contrasting surface (e.g. water plaza vs asphalt) that could bias the pair

source: Single non-local station wind applied uniformly (Barajas, or a peripheral municipal met station)
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: Possibly — street canyon channelling vs open plaza could differentially cool one route; not resolved without URock/CFD
known_limitations: No corridor-local wind (Escuelas Aguirre lacks wind; the six full met stations are peripheral); no spatial wind resolution (no URock/CFD this line)
gate2_proposed_treatment: Include wind treatment (uniform vs simple canyon adjustment) as a perturbation dimension; do NOT introduce CFD; if wind assumption flips the pair -> ABSTAIN

source: HATI locked asset table (used only as geographic endpoints; not as thermal evidence)
dataset_product: pilot_assets.csv rows A09 (Atocha) and A14 (Puerta de Alcala)
known_limitations: Asset POINT semantics = where a tourist stands (forecourt/entrance) not building centroid — fine for O-D endpoints
gate2_proposed_treatment: Use A09 and A14 coordinates as fixed O and D ONLY; do NOT reuse any locked HATI thermal/asset-ranking output as evidence for this extension

source: Ayuntamiento de Madrid Modelo Digital de Superficies (MDS) 2023 + Modelo Digital del Terreno (MDT) 2019
dataset_product: MDS 2023 (10 cm tiles / 1 m COG mosaic); MDT 2019
version_date_campaign: MDS from 2023 aerial survey (~100 pts/m2 photogrammetric point cloud); MDT 2019
spatial_resolution_support: 10 cm tiles; 1 m COG mosaic (MDS); municipal MDT 2019
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: Yes for BUILDINGS/terrain (2023 surface vs 2008-2015 materially changes shadow geometry for a 2023+ day); the building surface is the more reliable part
known_limitations: UNCLASSIFIED surface (top-of-everything: no building-vs-vegetation split); photogrammetric image-correlation (noisier over canopy, no sub-canopy/trunk); leaf-state fixed to the 2023 flight date; NOT LiDAR; needs MDS-MDT to get nDSM and a vegetation mask to separate canopy
gate2_proposed_treatment: PREFERRED terrain/building-surface source for a 2023+ study day: nDSM = MDS 2023 - MDT 2019; obtain by BOUNDED bbox clip to OD1 at Gate 2 (NOT now - Gate 1 forbids large raster download); separate buildings from canopy using a vegetation mask + tree inventory (L16); keep PNOA (L03/L04) as cross-check

source: Ayuntamiento de Madrid - Arbolado en parques y zonas verdes de Madrid (detalle)
dataset_product: Individually inventoried municipal trees (points; species; ALTURA height attribute)
version_date_campaign: 2025/2026 releases (current inventory; per-record vintage not dated)
limitation_can_change_comparison_directi: Indirectly — used to detect removals/additions vs old PNOA/MDS canopy and thus BOUND canopy uncertainty (E-P2), not to build the shade field directly
known_limitations: Provides presence + height + species only: NO crown polygons, NO historical 2021/2023 canopy, NO leaf state, NO hour-specific shade; per-record date absent (Phase 1.2 finding)
gate2_proposed_treatment: Use as a current tree-presence/removal audit to bound canopy change in E-P2 and flag canopy pixels contradicted by 2025/2026 reality; never treat as crown geometry or as historical canopy
